reason: W686 (#761): ModelDB 267710 (Moustafa et al. 2023, the 25-state motoneuron of ode_motoneuron6c) with follow_all_branches on, as one run: the steady run of ode_motoneuron6c (settled 1200 ms at ampPar 0, 600 points of ampPar each way) finds Hopf points whose cycles are jobs, and those cycle branches find branch points of cycles; three of them, on branches -4, -6 and -8 (labels 18, 33 and 39 of the six-job run), are one cycle (ampPar 0.194274, period 24.194, every state within the same-point rule). The diagram is the same at 1 and automatic threads, byte for byte. Before W686 it held 1931 points at 1 and 2 threads, 1770 at 4 and 1767 at 8: a job's start was judged made by an earlier job that had not finished, or that the join later dropped, so which jobs ran depended on the order they finished in. It holds no branch from the second and third of those points: the +DS run from the first goes round a loop of 6 points (W687, #762: it is a real closure, the closing cycle at the start's parameter 8e-8 of its size from the start's orbit and its period 1.5e-7 off, by tools/autox-profile/closure_check.py; the old rule closed it at its third point on a cycle a quarter of its size, which that check shows is another cycle), so the -DS run from any of them goes round the same loop, and the 164-point run the old 1-thread diagram had from the third retraced branch -4 beyond its label 18 (the cycles match -4's in parameter, period and every variable's maximum and minimum, and its five folds and its end at a Hopf point are -4's).
